name: Gorpcore
summary: Trail and camp gear worn in the city as fashion. A fleece, a bright shell, a down vest and ripstop trousers, with no wish to look polished.

philosophy.core_thesis: The best dress is the kind you would take on a hike: it looks plain, it is tough, and its colours come from the trail.
design_principles: Layer a fleece, a vest and a shell in three different colours.
Choose a trail trouser of ripstop nylon with a zip-off leg or a drawcord hem.
Wear a trail shoe or a sandal with a thick sole of 3 to 4 cm.
Add a cap or a bucket hat in the same cloth as the shell.
Keep gear details on show: toggles, drawcords and a bold zip.
Use bright blocks of colour in primary tones.
Wear the gear worn, with a mark of use.
anti_patterns: A black, stealth surface with no colour
A new-looking item with no gear detail
Fine, thin cloth that tears on a trail
A logo as the whole design

silhouette.shape: A loose, boxy mix of fleece, shell and vest in bright blocks of colour, over wide trail trousers and chunky shoes.
silhouette.line: A soft, dropped shoulder, a roomy, boxy body and a straight or tapered leg.
silhouette.fit: Loose and layered, with room for a fleece under a shell; the drawcords and toggles tune the fit.
silhouette.proportion: Jacket to the hip; wide leg of 22 to 26 cm at the hem; roughly 1 to 1.2 chest to hip.
rules: Put a fleece under a shell in a clashing colour.
Pair a loose top with a wide or a zip-off trail trouser.
Leave toggles, drawcords and cord locks on show.
Add a cap, a bucket hat or a small chest bag.
Wear a chunky trail shoe with a thick sole.

fabrics.rule: Choose the fleece, ripstop and membrane cloths of the trail, in bright blocks: the gear must look as if it could go on a mountain.

construction.closures: Front zips with a bold pull, cord locks and toggles at the hem and the hood, and hook-and-loop cuffs.
construction.details: A colour-block yoke, a chest zip pocket, a high fleece collar, bright zip pulls and a drawcord at the hem.

surface.pattern: Colour blocks and a plain fleece; a small outdoor graphic on a tee.
surface.gloss: Fleece at 1–3 GU; ripstop at 15–35 GU; shell at 15–50 GU.
surface.wear: The fleece pills and the shell scuffs; the style takes the signs of use as a good mark.

palette.strategy: Primary colour blocks against earth tones, with a safety orange or a red as the lead.

processes: knit and nap of polyester fleece
pattern cutting for a layered fit
sewing and taping in a factory
making.scale: Made in factories by outdoor firms in the thousand, and in small runs in a collaboration with a fashion label.
making.signs: A bright colour-block fleece, a shell in a clash colour, drawcords and toggles on show, and a chunky trail shoe.

pieces.form: Boxy fleece in colour blocks with a chest pocket
Bright membrane shell with a hood and a bold zip
Quilted vest in ripstop with a high collar
Wide trail trouser in ripstop with a zip-off leg

evidence.title: Balaclava of thin fabric with polar fleece

emotion.target_response: A warm, playful sense of the open air in the city: the wearer looks relaxed, practical and a little wry.

use_cases: a styling brief for an outdoor-gear collaboration
an image prompt for a street-style scene
a trend note on outdoor dress in the city
a product brief for a fleece line
avoid_when: the brief is formal or evening dress
the brief wants stealth black wear
the brief is a heritage, waxed look

modifiers.how: Dye the shell black, add pockets and buckles, and taper the leg.
Drop the colour blocks and logos, keep one muted tone and a clean cut.

ornament_level.note: Colour blocks and gear details carry the ornament; the cloth stays plain.
